answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25045 Country: India Title: I am 85 year old men. Unable to pray "taravih" and "roza" because of illness . So, what i do now ?. Please help me . If there is any alternate way , then please tell me. Question: I am 85 year old men. Unable to pray "taravih" and "roza" because of illness . So, what i do now ?. Please help me . If there is any alternate way , then please tell me. Answer ID: 25045 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1770/1297/H=1431) Offer tarawih salah though short or as much as you can, though sitting. And in future if you are sure that your energy of fast will not be restored, the fidya of one fast is equal to sadqatul fitr. Pay the fidya as of the fasts you missed. No fidya is fixed on missing tarawih. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
